an icy stare: When I interrupted her phone call, my sister gave me an icy stare that told me to leave immediately.
我打斷姊姊講電話時，她用冰冷的目光瞪我，示意我馬上離開。
an icy tone: "I don't need your help," she replied in an icy tone, without even looking up from her book.
「我不需要你的幫忙。」她用冰冷的語氣回答，連頭都沒從書上抬起來。
icy roads: Drivers in the mountains should slow down in winter because icy roads can cause serious accidents.
冬天在山區開車的駕駛應該減速，因為結冰的路面可能造成嚴重車禍。
an icy reception: When he returned after betraying the team, he got an icy reception; nobody smiled or said hello.
他背叛球隊後回來時受到冷淡的接待，沒有人對他微笑或打招呼。
be identical to: Your answers seem to be identical to Tom's, right down to the same spelling mistakes, so did you copy them?
你的答案看起來與湯姆的完全相同，連拼字錯誤都一樣，你是抄的嗎？
identical twins: Even their parents sometimes confuse the identical twins because they look exactly alike and wear the same clothes.
就連父母有時也會把那對同卵雙胞胎搞混，因為他們長得一模一樣又穿同樣的衣服。
almost identical: The two phones look almost identical, but one is much faster and costs twice as much.
這兩支手機看起來幾乎一模一樣，但其中一支快得多，價格也貴一倍。
in identical fashion: The two robberies were carried out in identical fashion, so police believe the same gang did both.
這兩起搶案是以完全相同的方式犯下的，所以警方認為是同一個集團所為。
idle gossip: Don't believe that story about our teacher; it is just idle gossip spread by bored students.
別相信那個關於我們老師的傳聞；那只是無聊學生散播的無聊閒話。
idle threats: Mom always says she will take away my phone, but I know they are idle threats.
媽媽總是說要沒收我的手機，但我知道那只是虛張聲勢的威脅。
lie idle: Since the factory closed, the land has been left to lie idle, covered with weeds and trash.
自從工廠關閉後，那塊地就一直閒置著，長滿雜草、堆滿垃圾。
idle curiosity: I asked about her salary out of idle curiosity, not because I wanted to change jobs.
我問她的薪水只是出於一時好奇，而不是因為我想換工作。
an idle moment: In an idle moment between classes, I like to read a few pages of my favorite novel.
在下課的空閒時刻，我喜歡讀幾頁我最愛的小說。
idle away the hours: Instead of studying for the exam, he would idle away the hours playing games on his phone.
他不準備考試，反而會用手機玩遊戲虛度時光。
idle machinery: Because there were no orders, the factory was full of idle machinery and workers with nothing to do.
由於沒有訂單，工廠裡滿是閒置的機器和無事可做的工人。
be ignorant of the facts: Many people who complain online seem to be ignorant of the facts and only repeat what they heard.
許多在網路上抱怨的人似乎不知道事實，只是重複他們聽到的話。
an ignorant remark: Saying that girls are bad at math was an ignorant remark that upset everyone in the class.
說女生數學很差是一句無知的言論，讓全班都很不高興。
remain ignorant about: Without the news, many villagers would remain ignorant about the dangers of the coming storm.
如果沒有新聞，許多村民會對即將來臨的暴風雨的危險一無所知。
an imaginary friend: When she was four, my little sister had an imaginary friend named Bobo whom only she could see.
我妹妹四歲時有個只有她看得見、名叫波波的想像中的朋友。
imaginary fears: The child's imaginary fears about monsters under the bed kept him awake every night.
那孩子擔心床底下有怪物的無謂恐懼，讓他每晚都睡不著。
an imaginary line: The equator is an imaginary line that divides the Earth into the northern and southern halves.
赤道是一條把地球分成南北兩半的假想線。
an imaginative solution: The students came up with an imaginative solution: they turned old plastic bottles into a school garden.
學生們想出一個富有想像力的解決方案：把舊塑膠瓶變成學校花園。
imaginative writing: The teacher praised Ben's imaginative writing, especially his story about a cat that could travel through time.
老師稱讚班富創意的寫作，特別是他那篇關於一隻能穿越時空的貓的故事。
a highly imaginative child: Leo is a highly imaginative child who turns cardboard boxes into spaceships, castles, and pirate ships.
里歐是個想像力豐富的孩子，會把紙箱變成太空船、城堡和海盜船。
the immediate future: We have no plans to move in the immediate future, but we may buy a bigger house in a few years.
我們在最近的將來沒有搬家的計畫，但幾年後可能會買間大一點的房子。
one's immediate family: Only my immediate family, my parents and my brother, were invited to the small wedding.
只有我的直系親屬——我爸媽和我哥哥——受邀參加這場小型婚禮。
the immediate area: After the gas leak, police asked everyone in the immediate area to leave their homes right away.
瓦斯外洩後，警方要求鄰近地區的所有人立刻離開家。
take immediate action: When the fire alarm rang, the teacher had to take immediate action and lead the students outside within seconds.
火警鈴響時，老師必須立即採取行動，在幾秒內帶學生到外面。
an immediate response: I sent a message to customer service and got an immediate response, less than a minute later.
我傳訊息給客服，不到一分鐘就得到即時回應。
one's immediate superior: If you want a day off, you should first ask your immediate superior, the manager you report to.
如果你想請假，應該先問你的直屬上司，也就是你直接向他報告的經理。
the immediate cause: The immediate cause of the accident was a driver who ran a red light while looking at his phone.
這起車禍的直接原因是一名邊看手機邊闖紅燈的駕駛。
